description:
Kia mārama te kite i te mahinga.

Tīmata i te paepae e hiahia ana koe ki te whakamātau. Mā LumaTrace koe e ārahi ki te hipanga e whai ake nei, ā, ka waiho ngā inenga kāore i te wātea hei N/A.

Windows: Kōwhiria he tukanga taupānga, kēmu rānei i tēnei PC, kātahi tīmatahia te whakamātau. Ki te mutu te tukanga, ka mutu te wāhanga, ka tuhi rānei i tētahi aukatinga mārama.

Android: Whakahohea ngā kōwhiringa Kaiwhakawhanake me te USB debugging i te waea, whakamanahia tēnei PC, huakina te taupānga hei whakamātau, kātahi pāwhiria Tīmata whakamātautau. Ka rapu aunoa a LumaTrace i te mōkī kei mua.

Kōwhiria he hua whakamātautau kia kite i te FPS, 1% Low, wā tāpare, CPU, mahara me ngā pūrongo kua kaweake.

Ka penapena a Android i tētahi ADB logcat kua purea mō te wā whakamātautau. Ka penapena a Windows i ngā pūkete wāhanga LumaTrace whai waitohu-wā.

Ka noho ngā uara ngaro hei N/A, ā, e kore rawa e whakakīia ki te 0.

Kāore e tuku ki te kapua
features: Kāore e tuku ki te kapua
